#+TITLE: Test fixture derivation

* Confined-water trajectory

=input/traj/confined_water_40.{gro,xtc}= contains the first three frames
of the supplied 40-molecule TIP4P/2005 confined-water trajectory. The
GRO carries the matching topology: framework residue =COF=, fluid
residue =SOL=, and ghost residue =SOLX=.

Recreate both files from a build with chemfiles enabled:

#+begin_src sh
sh tests/fixtures/derive_confined_water_fixture.sh BUILD-DIR \
  /path/to/hb-40 input/traj/confined_water_40
#+end_src

The input prefix names =hb-40.gro= and =hb-40.xtc=. The helper reads
three XTC frames with the GRO topology and writes the same frames to
both output formats.
